el.Música, pintura e intuición. Donde el so: Music, painting and intuition. Where sound becomes color.
el.Soy artista visual y cantante. Mi trabaj: I'm a visual artist and singer. My work is born at the intersection of music and painting: I explore how rhythm, texture and color can translate what we hear, turning sound into gesture, into matter, into art.
el.Comparto esta experiencia a través de Mú: I share this experience through Música a la Obra, a workshop where I invite you to create intuitive paintings inspired by the music you choose. I also take part in live music projects, and my pieces are part of spaces and collections.
el.La música deja de sonar, pero sigue reso: The music stops playing, but it keeps resonating in the work.

at.Jimena Mercedes · Artista visual y canta: Jimena Mercedes · Visual artist and singer
